pull_requests.title: Prove all-field rank formula for biforms with one polynomial top coefficient
pull_requests.body:
## New mathematical result

For any field K, a >= 2, 1 <= e < b, and f(x,z) = c_0 + ... + c_(e-1) z^(e-1) + w(x) z^e with nonzero constant c_0, constant lower coefficients, and nonzero deg(w)=d<a, the literal full cyclic-source biform matrix satisfies

    rank R_(a,b)(f) = ab + sum_(j=0)^(e-1) min(b, d floor((a+j)/e)).

This holds in every characteristic, with no additional coefficient guard. In particular, it handles the genuine three-term non-diagonal f=1+z+(1+x^d)z^2 and all e>=2. The proof parametrizes the e free terminal polynomial coordinates, then establishes predictable degrees using a residue-indexed triangular leading-coefficient matrix. It retains every original source coefficient column.

## Evidence

- 900 exhaustive GF(2) and 1,836 exhaustive GF(3) full-source rank comparisons;
- 216 deterministic GF(5)/GF(7)/GF(101) comparisons and 420 exact degree witnesses;
- 24 separately implemented direct-coefficient SymPy/QQ ranks;
- three focused unittests, including an off-by-one mutation control, passed locally.

Totals: 3,372 exact modular ranks plus 24 characteristic-zero checks, all passing. Commands, code, pinned receipt and a precise continuation record are committed. Local environment: Python 3.13.5 / SymPy 1.14.0. Global repository regression and historical archive replay were not completed in this run because the isolated public-network Pyroam runner returned an internal error; hosted current-head required CI remains mandatory.

## Claims and dependencies

Adds AI-TOP-COEFFICIENT-BIFORM-RANK-001 with status **proof-written-unreviewed**, independent_review=false, improves_omega=false. Credits original literal source convention (pinned source blob), preceding affine-z result #209 at its exact head, and distinct #171/#186/#207 research. No unmerged runtime dependency or external theorem is imported. Both archived 2026-10-20 research directories are untouched.

Concurrent consolidation #214 may change STATUS, PROVENANCE and the claim ledger on main. Reconcile the new main and rerun all required checks before any merge; do not silently overwrite its source records.

## Limitations

The theorem classifies *individual* biform source slices with constant lower coefficients. General u(x)+z*v(x)+z^2*w(x) minimal indices, compatible three-leg tensor maps, auxiliary cost, and a full asymptotic exponent implication remain open. No arithmetic exponent improvement below 9/4 or independent mathematical review is asserted.

**Do not merge** until current-head required CI passes, all review discussions are resolved, and the claim proof is checked against the exact stated family.

pull_requests.title: Exhibit identical-resultant three-term cyclic slices of ranks 14 and 15
pull_requests.body:
## Exact result
For the literal 15x15 cyclic-source coefficient matrix at a=b=3 and f=x²+z(1+x²)+z²(1+t x+c x²), an exact polynomial identity gives
`det R = t(2c³-2ct²+t⁴)`.
The two specializations (c,t)=(2,0) and (1,1) each have coefficient degrees (2,2,2), primitive degree 2, and all three pairwise resultants equal to 1, yet ranks 14 and 15 over every field of characteristic not 2. The first has an explicit integral left kernel and a -4 minor; the second has unit determinant.

This disproves classification of the rank by those coarse invariants. It **does not** prove a source-space cap, tensor degeneration, or exponent below 9/4.

## Evidence
- Written proof and complete matrix convention: research/ai/2026-10-23-three-term-resultant-obstruction/proof.md
- Dependency-free 256-point integer polynomial identity certificate, exact minor, and modular rank controls: verify.py, saved report under results/three-term-resultant-obstruction-2026-10-23/
- Focused test locally passed: `python -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_three_term_resultant_obstruction.py' -v`.
- `python -I research/ai/2026-10-23-three-term-resultant-obstruction/verify.py` passed.
- Whole-repository regression, historical archive replay, and hosted required CI are not yet verified on this branch. Do not merge until they pass.

## Provenance and next question
Claim `AI-THREE-TERM-RESULTANT-OBSTRUCTION-001`, status **proof-written-unreviewed**. Literal source convention pinned to blob `04d28c6a05027a7756891f47d28327de850a7501`; prior affine recurrence remains credited to PR #209 (head `4247f42`, superseded by consolidation PR #214). PR #207 owns diagonal Toeplitz problems. This investigation concerns non-diagonal coefficient triples.

Next: compute the two polynomial-kernel minimal indices of `u λ_r+v λ_(r+1)+w λ_(r+2)=0` and determine sufficient higher subresultant/syzygy invariants. Avoid another search using only pairwise resultants.

Consolidation PR #214 is concurrently integrating prior branches and may require a documentation/ledger rebase before this PR can merge.

pull_requests.title: Reduce a full-source two-sided A4 construction to a 46-dimensional compression problem
pull_requests.body:
## Result

This PR studies the complete 112-dimensional normalized A4 source under two-sided conjugation by `I+t^-1 N`, where the credited source slice N has rank 16 and N²=0. It allows arbitrary constant rank-110 input/output compressions and arbitrary Laurent first maps.

The full saturated limit L acts by scalars on a fixed 12-dimensional subspace. Compression can recover directions after killing leading coefficients, but it recovers at most the number lost. A full M(10,10,11) target therefore requires at least nine lost directions: `dim(P L C) <= 103`.

The structural continuation proves that every element of L of ordinary rank at most four lies entirely in its bottom-left 28-by-28 block. That block is the explicit 46-dimensional space `E = G + [G,F] + F G F`, with F=G00. Consequently a successful arbitrary constant compression requires rank-26 outer maps with `dim(Phat E Chat) <= 37`. This is a necessary condition; arbitrary noncoordinate compressions remain open.

## Complete coordinate exclusions

The original census checks all 6,216 principal two-coordinate deletions of L. Every projected dimension is at least 108 over C, so none meets the nine-direction requirement.

The latest continuation covers all **142,884 independent two-row / two-column deletions** of E. Modular ranks at 1009 give complex lower bounds with histogram:

| Dimension modulo 1009 | Pairs |
| --- | ---: |
| 40 | 2 |
| 41 | 59 |
| 42 | 1,482 |
| 43 | 2,168 |
| 44 | 19,151 |
| 45 | 15,096 |
| 46 | 104,926 |

Two exact integer six-dimensional kernel witnesses attain dimension 40. Thus every independent coordinate compression of the complete fixed family loses at most six directions, and the entire coordinate class is excluded. This does not classify arbitrary complex flags.

## Completed principal-pair explorations

Two further specified singular paths retain every source slice:

| Path | Principal pairs | Exact re-saturations | Survivors |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Two noncommuting square-zero factors | 6,216 | 0 | 0 |
| Moving unit from their nonnilpotent sum | 6,216 | 221 | 0 |

All 221 re-saturations have complete rational polynomial replay and an exact invariant-subspace obstruction. The note also proves `ell >= 10*ceil((s-2)/11)-1`, giving required loss 29 for the first path's 29-dimensional scalar-action subspace.

## Validation

Reviewed head: `3b2eb05abac534da201b4ec411e914182cb46b8a`.
Reviewed tree: `35090c7ceee3a22d30f20f34ae7989d71fb9b6d8`.

- All 15 package tests passed: eight original conjugation tests, three block-reduction tests, and four independent-coordinate tests.
- Nine repository metadata and archive checks passed. Source pins also passed within the package tests.
- The complete independent-coordinate census and both sharpness witnesses replayed successfully. Both exploratory reports reproduced byte-identically, including all 221 exact re-saturations.
- Historical full-regression evidence covers 905 unique test IDs at frozen tree `363271b34a2b82dd033b388d7b48d00f1e76d1f9`. Its disclosed scratch-link failure and successful correction are retained. This is not a fresh full-suite run on the current tree.
- All 295 claims from main remain unchanged. Existing implementations, tests, and archive bytes are preserved.

Required hosted CI must pass before merge.

## Scope and attribution

The four claims—`AI-A4-TWOSIDED-RANKLOSS-001`, `AI-A4-TWOSIDED-COORDINATE-002`, `AI-A4-TWOSIDED-LOWRANK-003`, and `AI-A4-INDEPENDENT-COORDINATE-004`—remain `proof-written-unreviewed`.

The original tensor, normalization, source slice, and minimum-rank theorem retain their existing attribution and exact pins. Arbitrary noncoordinate compressions, moving compressions, and other singular paths remain open. No full target, exponent improvement, historical priority, formalization, or independent mathematical review is claimed. Root and sibling-agent checks belong to the same generating session.
